frame: BODY-JOINT frame, wear-seated: strand verts skinned by the part skeleton driven by the BODY skeleton at bind (per-joint world delta); runtime treats bake space as sim space, anchors follow the body Head bone

binLayout.vertOrder: prims in header order, GLB vertex order within each prim
binLayout.deform: pos = P_g(s) + Frame_g(s) * (relA * off), Frame columns (T,N,B) interpolated along the CURRENT guide polyline (RMF propagated from the posed root frame). Bind round-trip gated <=2mm at bake time (float32).
